report:
Reviewed the complete unmatched_end claim and all ordinary implementation/test entries. In spec.rs parse_anchors starts with no active anchor; a recognized explicit end with active.is_none() emits a diagnostic at that marker. finish_anchor takes the active value, so repeated ends and ends after ATX/Setext headings correctly fail. A new definition, heading, or end of input finishes without requiring an explicit marker. from_sources parses each document independently, and load_workspace/add_chapter_text parse each Sage prose block independently, preserving source boundaries.

All three associated test bodies were inspected. unmatched_ends_are_errors_after_explicit_implicit_and_source_boundaries checks initial and repeated markers, both heading forms, exact diagnostic count/message/span, and a marker in a separate document. Its single-error assertions also exclude spurious missing-closer errors for heading termination. claims_retain_all_blocks_until_the_next_definition_or_document_end asserts no diagnostics and exact retained contents/spans for adjacent definitions and document termination without explicit markers. an_end_marker_in_another_sage_prose_block_is_unmatched asserts retained first-block content, precisely one no-active-anchor error, correct file and marker span in the later block. Together these assertions detect lost active-state clearing, improperly shared document/block state, and erroneous mandatory closing markers. Captured source() and BookFixture setup/load helpers are straightforward construction and real SpecIndex invocation; assertions remain visible in the tests. No TODO/N/A entries or deferral prerequisites exist.

Baseline verification: independently compared the historical snapshots to current bytes. spec.rs is an exact match. The sole tests/spec.rs delta changes an unrelated review-inventory claim accessor to the fragments representation; the three associated test bodies are unchanged. Historical rationale remains supported by the current claim and evidence, rather than being accepted solely from its prior verdict. This is source review: I executed review start/read, snapshot comparisons and source inspection, then review record; I ran no behavior tests or build. The coordinator separately reports 321 passing sage-meta functional tests and a passing root cargo build, which are not my execution evidence. No source edits or requested changes.
